message:
The other night, we had a little blackout in our neighborhood, and I couldn’t help but chuckle at my friend Sarah. She’s the one who always panics when the lights go out. I mean, she was frantically texting me, "What do we do?" while I was just cozying up with my trusty flashlight and a good book. 

I get it, though! Those moments can feel a bit unsettling, especially if you're not prepared. I reminded her that having a few extra power banks charged and some lanterns handy can really help keep the mood light and comfortable. 

How do you handle a power outage? I'd love to hear your tips!
